evidence: Carries the Consensus label and modifies interpreter execution in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/script/interpreter.h.
rationale: Implements BIP-347 OP_CAT in Tapscript, a major proposed soft fork opcode that provides long-sought string and byte concatenation capabilities. Soft fork proposals require deliberate validation review to verify interpreter correctness and reach community decisions, but because this PR deliberately omits activation parameters and does not address an urgent defect, it is strategically important rather than category-critical.
